svg.title: Choosing a Foundry Model
svg.desc: Decision tree. Is it complex reasoning or a long document? If yes, choose a proprietary solution such as GPT-4 or Claude. If no, is it budget-sensitive or an edge deployment? If yes, choose Phi-3, a lightweight model. If no, is open source or cost control wanted? If yes, choose an open-source solution such as Llama 3 or Mistral; if no, choose the proprietary solution.
svg.text: Match model capability to the task; bigger is not always better.
